name: azure-devops-task
description: Azure DevOps task for running VigilWeave scans

scripts.build: rm -rf dist VigilWeaveScan && tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p VigilWeaveScan && cp -R dist VigilWeaveScan/dist && cp task.json VigilWeaveScan/task.json
scripts.package: mkdir -p packaged && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path packaged
